# tedplugin — TedPlay

Commodore **264 series** (16 / 116 / Plus/4) **TED** chip music.

Extensions: `.prg`

`.prg` is a bare Commodore executable, so this plugin only claims the TED tunes
from the HVTC corpus. VIC-20 and PET `.prg` files are *not* covered — those would
need `xvic`/`xpet` and are left unindexed. Commodore VIC-20 tracker music has its
own path: [victrackerplugin](../victrackerplugin/README.md).
